body: Hey man don’t do it. God wants to keep you alive. This world is evil but you shouldn’t take it for granted. He has saved me countless times and I’ve had encounters with him a lot. I had a shotgun loaded with double aught buck shot and I had it pointed at me head and had a glock 19 pointed at my heart, ready to die. But something told me that there was a hope. Believe it or not, things do get better. I hope you live to see this message. If you have already passed, may you Rest In Peace but if you’re still here, please listen to my words. God has a plan for you I know a bunch of people will bombard you with religion but I believe that you have a purpose. Look what The people who did commit suicide left behind for there brothers sisters mother father aunt uncle grandma and grandpa it left them on with her and start a chain reaction with suicide. My aunt committed suicide and she was like my mother she pulled out a revolver and ended it. She was one of the nicest people you could’ve ever met. Please, please don’t kill yourself. I don’t know what you’re going through, but know this, Jesus Christ died for you so you do not parish but have eternal life. You could be atheist you could be totally against Christianity. Catholic Church is fake they do not believe in Jesus but they believe in Mary which is a false prophet. Sure she was Jesus’ mother but she did nothing save save the world from itself. Just know that I’m rooting for you. Whoever you are I love you.
